description: Planning-stage evaluation suite (fixture-backed). Each task points at a setup-only fixture built by eval/bootstrap_fixtures.py and tests only the planning stage — no per-task setup call. Covers volume-fraction (NVT), pressure (NPT), per-component shape parameters, relative volume fraction, two-axis sweeps, and an adversarial NVT+pressure mismatch. Prereq: python eval/bootstrap_fixtures.py

user_profiles.description: Describes the workflow in natural language and expects the agent to structure the process.
Uses domain-specific language and expects concise workflow handling with minimal handholding.
Uses incomplete, slightly inconsistent, or poorly phrased requests to test robustness.

metadata.fixture_note: Build setup-only fixtures with `python eval/bootstrap_fixtures.py` (~seconds). Each task then exercises only the planning step. NOTE: planning tasks append runs to the fixture's simulation_plan.json; for clean isolation between LLMs, --force rebuild the fixtures between full eval passes.
